Great app in general, really creative way to learn and have fun at the same time. Some points I noticed that this app may improve: 1) The Date component used to input Date of birth is so bad from UX perspective, it took me some time to realize that the year at the top is clickable to change the year, instead of endless swipes to change the months only. 2) The Arena page is too colorful, it looks nice but it's distracting, it's hard to see which element to click, maybe consider changing the background or at least reduce the tone a bit will help. 3) This only happens occasionally and may not be easy to reproduce but sometimes after I finish a Speaking challenge, the interface is switched to Vietnamese (I chose to display the interface in English). More things may popup as I experience the app longer, but hope these points are considered :)
